'''Haakon''' was a gambler who mortgaged his family holdings to pay a gambling debt to [[Narloch]]. Haakon claimed the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] match had been rigged, but [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officials determined that the match had been fair and required Haakon to pay. Some time later, Haakon placed a bounty on Narloch, requesting he be captured alive.
